article:
Test 8
For each question, choose the correct answer.
Jane Goodall
Jane Goodall is well known for her research into animals called chimpanzees. From early childhood, she (21).................. of going to see them in their natural environment in Africa.
In order to (22).................. the journey, she did a variety of part-time jobs. When she was 23, she had enough money to visit a friend in Kenya. During her time there, Jane fell in love with the country. She was (23).................. a job studying chimpanzees in a national park. At the time, she had no special training for working with animals. She was surprised to find that this (24).................. helped her, as she had to (25).................. her own way of watching and recording the chimpanzees' actions.
She discovered many new things about the animals, like the fact that they ate meat. Before that, scientists thought they only ate plants, but Jane (26).................. that this was not true.

questions.explanation:
B. dreamed
解析：“dream of doing sth.” 为固定搭配，意为 “梦想做某事”，符合简・古道尔从小梦想去非洲观察黑猩猩的语境。
A. imagined（想象）后直接接宾语，不接 “of”；C. hoped（希望）和 D. wished（希望）后接不定式 “to do”，不接 “of doing”。
拓展：“dream” 还可搭配 “about”，如 “dream about sth.”，强调 “梦见某事”。

A. afford
解析：“afford the journey” 表示 “负担得起旅程的费用”，符合她做兼职攒钱的逻辑。
B. pay（支付）需搭配 “for”，即 “pay for sth.”；C. spend（花费）后接时间或金钱，搭配 “on sth.” 或 “(in) doing”；
D. earn（赚取）与 “journey” 搭配不当，应为 “earn money”。
拓展：“afford” 常接否定词，如 “can't afford sth.”，表示 “负担不起”。

C. offered
解析：“was offered a job” 为被动结构，意为 “被提供一份工作”，符合她在肯尼亚被邀请研究黑猩猩的语境。
A. applied（申请）需接 “for”，即 “apply for a job”；B. provided（提供）的正确搭配为 “provide sb. with sth.” 或 “provide sth. for sb.”；D. accepted（接受）与 “was...a job” 搭配时，应为 “was accepted for a job”，但此处强调 “被给予工作机会”，而非 “接受”。
拓展：“offer sb. sth.” = “offer sth. to sb.”，主动语态中表示 “给某人提供某物”。

D. actually
解析：“actually” 表示 “实际上”，强调 “没有专业训练反而帮助了她” 的转折关系。
A. completely（完全地）、B. specially（特别地）、C. properly（恰当地）均不符合 “无训练却有益” 的逻辑。
拓展：“actually” 常用于纠正观点或强调事实，如 “I thought he was wrong, but actually he was right.”

A. develop
解析：“develop one's own way” 意为 “形成自己的方法”，指她不得不自创观察和记录方式。
B. reach（达到）、C. control（控制）、D. gain（获得）均无法与 “way” 合理搭配。
拓展：“develop” 还可表示 “发展；开发”，如 “develop a plan（制定计划）”“develop a skill（培养技能）”。

D. proved
解析：“proved” 表示 “证明”，指简通过研究证实黑猩猩吃肉，推翻了科学家之前的观点。
A. persuaded（说服）后接人，即 “persuade sb. to do”；B. agreed（同意）需接 “with/on”，且不符合 “推翻旧观点” 的语境；C. intended（打算）后接 “to do”，与句意无关。
拓展：“prove” 可接宾语从句或 “prove sth. to be + adj.”，如 “She proved that he was lying.”
